home.description: Discover 3D archaeological replicas and interactive history directly in the museum's open area.
home.cameraWarning: Camera permission and good lighting are required

ar.orientationWarning: To scan markers, rotate your phone to landscape.

valdivia.name: Figurine FS-3312 (Valdivia V)
valdivia.desc: Figurine head with oblique occipital cranial deformation and a clay mask-shaped headdress extending over the nose. Smoothed and polished surface with reddish-yellow tones (Munsell 5YR 7/6–7/8), deeply incised eyes and mouth.

vasija.name: Vessel E-3 / Artifact No. 350 (Valdivia Phase IV)
vasija.desc: Globular vessel with bell-shaped neck and spheroid body. Features rounded lip, everted rim, and neck decorated with zig-zag incisions. Polished finish with red slip on the lip and inner neck.

vasija2.name: Pot Artifact No. 181 (Valdivia Phase III-VII)
vasija2.desc: Deep globular pot with short straight neck, sharp lip, and everted rim. Classified as Valdivia broad-line incised (Type 16), polished surfaces, light-red slip exterior and light-brown interior.
vasija2.material: Polished ceramic / Red & brown slip / Broad-line incised

choza2_realalto.name: Valdivia Hut
choza2_realalto.desc: 3D representation of the pre-Columbian Valdivia Hut.

choza.name: Real Alto Hut
choza.desc: Communal residential and ceremonial structure of the Valdivia culture at Real Alto, built with wooden posts, praise cane, and thatch roofing.

entierro.name: Reconstruction of Principal Woman Burial (Tomb XXIV)
entierro.desc: Funerary bundle with false head and Valdivia 3 ceramic mask of a high-ranking woman (~35 years old), within a tomb paved with grinding stones and metates. Accompanied by the burial of a young man (~20 years old) with a segmented skeleton, seven chert knives, and a deer mandible.
entierro.location: Threshold of Structure 7, Charnel Mound (Trench B, Tomb B-XXIV)
